WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
cross_rating_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS avg_per_day_rate
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  r.rating,
  r.avg_replacement_cost,
  r.avg_per_day_rate,
  r.avg_per_day_rate - c.avg_per_day_rate AS above_cross_rating_average
FROM rating_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN cross_rating_average AS c
WHERE r.avg_per_day_rate > c.avg_per_day_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Per-day rate means each film's rental_rate divided by its rental_duration, averaged across films within each rating; the cross-rating average is the simple unweighted average of those rating averages.
